script: If the Sun became a black hole with the same mass, Earth would keep orbiting normally. Black holes do not suck things in like a vacuum cleaner. From far away, their gravity is the same as any object with that much mass. The danger is only up close, near the event horizon. Don't worry, the Sun is far too small to ever become a black hole.
